# pcre2
FetchContent_Declare(pcre2
  GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/PCRE2Project/pcre2
  GIT_TAG        pcre2-10.44
)
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_BUILD_PCRE2_8 ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_BUILD_PCRE2_16 OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_BUILD_PCRE2_32 OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_BUILD_TESTS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(PCRE2_BUILD_PCREGREP OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(pcre2)
set(_pcre2_resolved_via "fetch" CACHE INTERNAL "")

# manifest entry: pcre2
if(NOT _spice_first)
  string(APPEND _spice_manifest ",\n")
endif()
set(_spice_first FALSE)
FetchContent_GetProperties(pcre2)
if(EXISTS "${pcre2_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
  set(_spice_pcre2_inc "${pcre2_SOURCE_DIR}/include")
else()
  set(_spice_pcre2_inc "${pcre2_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()
set(_spice_pcre2_bld "${pcre2_BINARY_DIR}")
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "  \"pcre2\": {\n"
  "    \"resolved_via\": \"${_pcre2_resolved_via}\",\n"
)
string(APPEND _spice_manifest
  "    \"include_dirs\": [\"${_spice_pcre2_inc}\"],\n"
  "    \"link_dirs\":    [\"${_spice_pcre2_bld}\"],\n"
  "    \"link_libs\":    [\"pcre2\"]\n"
)
string(APPEND _spice_manifest "  }")
